about: Enjoy the start of the main game up to the beginning of Chapter 2. Save data carries over to the full version, allowing you to seamlessly continue your progress.
In addition, this demo version is compatible with version 1.12, offering a more refined and polished gameplay experience.
Experience features of the full version, such as: • The historic streets of a fantastical 1930s Tokyo.
• A unique cast, enhanced from the original experience with full VO.
• Fight alongside demon allies in real-time battles.
• The art of confinement, a fun system to capture demons and turn them into allies. Over 100 demons can be recruited, leveled up, and added to the party.
